GOES_to_RD174_unit_contract.goes_native: J(E): protons cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1 keV^-1
GOES_to_RD174_unit_contract.internal: J(E): protons cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1 MeV^-1 (numeric x1000)
GOES_to_RD174_unit_contract.solid_angle_step: F_4pi(E)=4*pi*J(E), performed once immediately before RADAR
GOES_to_RD174_unit_contract.radar_input: differential flux protons cm^-2 s^-1 MeV^-1 (no sr^-1)
GOES_to_RD174_unit_contract.rd174: F_VEP(E) in (cm^2 s MeV)^-1, differential spectrum of isotropic proton flux in full solid angle Omega=4*pi; eq. (6.6) nu=integral Sigma(E)F(E)dE
GOES_to_RD174_unit_contract.interpretation: The 4*pi step is not a claim that East or West is a measured omnidirectional spectrum. Each direction is separately promoted to an isotropy-equivalent scenario; E/W disagreement is retained as a diagnostic.

sigma_E_interface.main: log-log interpolation between positive experimental points; unresolved 29-MeV point omitted; local linear continuation below 0.9 MeV to nonnegative zero-crossing; constant hold above highest point
sigma_E_interface.reason_partial: The response below 0.9 MeV and above the experimental high-energy endpoint is extrapolated; the 5-40 MeV gap includes the unresolved 29-MeV point. Shielding transports a substantial fraction of the rate weight into the ~1 MeV region, making interpolation/extrapolation sensitivity material.

RADAR_shielding.high_energy_nuclear_support: TENDL-derived nonelastic/secondary tables end at 200 MeV; no invented reaction model is extrapolated above 200 MeV.

lambda_bit.why: A reproducible scenario series is computed for all shields, but absolute values remain model-sensitive because sigma_bit(E) is not experimentally supported over every output energy that contributes materially; d=0 additionally requires an explicit 0.614-0.92 MeV environmental-spectrum extrapolation.

tests.deterministic_regeneration: rate/audit/summary/sigma outputs reproduced byte-for-byte before final schema extension; final calculation rerun after schema/audit changes

hard_stop_disposition: No unsupported quantity is labeled as measured absolute truth. Where direct support is incomplete, the release is explicitly PARTIAL/scenario-based with sensitivity columns; therefore the hard-stop is respected rather than bypassed.
